title: Ecovacs Deebot X12S OmniCyclone Black Friday deal: Save $400.99 at Amazon
excerpt: Packs a self-washing roller mop, anti-tangle pet brushes, and a bagless dock that never needs replacement dust bags.
content_html:
SAVE $400.99: As of Nov. 25, the Ecovacs Deebot X12S OmniCyclone robot vacuum and mop is on sale for $899 at Amazon, down from its $1,299.99 list price. That's a 31% discount for Black Friday and Cyber Monday.

Credit: Ecovacs

$899 at Amazon
$1,299.99 Save $400.99

Spending your holiday weekend vacuuming up embedded pet hair and scrubbing dried kitchen spills off the floor gets old fast, which makes this Ecovacs Deebot X12S OmniCyclone deal at Amazon an easy way to hand off your floor chores. Introduced at IFA 2026, the hybrid robot vacuum and mop is marked down to $899, knocking $400.99 off its usual $1,299.99 list price for Black Friday and Cyber Monday.

The Deebot X12S OmniCyclone delivers 53 air watts of cleaning power — 60 percent more than the previous-generation X12 — alongside a sealed dust-mite chamber designed to extract deeply embedded dirt and allergens from carpet fibers. Anti-tangle brushes help prevent pet and human hair from wrapping around the main and side rollers, while its 3.86-inch slim profile slides under couches and beds, using obstacle avoidance and adaptive climbing to navigate thresholds and clutter without getting stuck.

The best tech deal this week

The Apple iPhone 18 Pro is free right now with T-Mobile

When it switches to mopping, it ditches flat spinning pads for a 10.6-inch roller mop that pre-sprays tough stains to loosen buildup before scrubbing at 220 RPM with continuous fresh water and a real-time dirty-water scraper. The roller extends outward to mop right along baseboards and furniture edges, and whenever the robot detects carpet, a protective cover closes over the wet roller and lifts it 0.59 inches so your rugs stay dry.

The included OmniCyclone dock handles most of the messy upkeep on its own, without requiring disposable dust bags; instead, it empties debris directly into a reusable container. It also washes the roller with hot water, dries both the mop and internal airway with 145-degree hot air to prevent mildew odors, and tops up the battery during wash cycles — plus you can control it hands-free with built-in YIKO voice commands.
